item.title: [Olympiad / Carnival] Blockchain & AI Olympiad Bangladesh 2026
item.description:
Category: Olympiad / Carnival

Date: 03 August - 09 September 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-08-15

Venue: Online / Hybrid

Fee: TBA

Details: Organized by Blockchain Olympiad Bangladesh (BCOLBD), the Blockchain & AI Olympiad Bangladesh 2026 invites ambitious students and recent graduates to solve real-world problems and showcase groundbreaking solutions in Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence. Participants present whitepapers and project prototypes for a chance to represent Bangladesh on an international stage.

Sub-Events:

  • Registration & Whitepaper Submission Phase: Registration runs from August 3 to August 15, 2026. Registered teams must submit their whitepapers between August 14 and August 16, 2026.
  • Evaluation & Winner Announcement: Primary results are declared by the end of August 2026. Finalists submit updated deliverables on September 2, 2026, leading to final evaluations (September 4–9, 2026) and winner announcements in mid-September 2026.

item.title: [Idea & Bizcomps] Blueprint 2026
item.description:
Category: Idea & Bizcomps

Date: August 4 - August 27, 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-08-03

Venue: Hybrid (Online & Offline)

Fee: BDT 499

Details: Blueprint is the flagship international financial modeling competition of the NSU Finance Club and proudly stands as Bangladesh's first and only international financial case competition. Designed for ambitious undergraduate students from around the world, Blueprint bridges academic knowledge with practical application by challenging participants to solve contemporary financial and business problems through critical thinking, strategic analysis, and collaborative decision-making. Teams must consist of 3–5 currently enrolled undergraduate students, and cross-university teams are allowed. The Total Prize Pool is BDT 650,000, with BDT 300,000 for the Champion.

Sub-Events:

  • August 4, 2026 | Round One — Due Diligence : Participants will complete an online assessment evaluating their understanding of financial concepts, analytical reasoning, and fundamental business principles on August 4, 2026.
  • August 7, 2026 | Workshop 01 (Offline): Teams advancing from Round One will attend an interactive in-person workshop on August 7, 2026, focused on financial case analysis, valuation methodologies, forecasting techniques, and structured problem-solving.
  • August 14, 2026 | Round Two — Investment Thesis: Teams will analyze a financial case and submit their proposed solutions online between August 7-10, 2026. Shortlisted teams will be invited to present their solutions before a distinguished panel of judges in an offline evaluation on August 14, 2026.
  • August 18, 2026 | Workshop 02 (Online): Finalist teams will participate in an exclusive online workshop led by industry professionals on August 18, 2026, exploring advanced financial analysis, strategic decision-making, and effective case presentation.
  • August 27, 2026 | Grand Finale — The Boardroom: The finale case will be released online on August 19, 2026, and finalist teams will submit their proposed solutions online by August 25, 2026. The final offline evaluation and presentation before a panel of academics and industry experts will take place on August 27, 2026.

item.title: [Hackathons] i-BIOHACKATHON 2026: SOLVING BIOLOGICAL QUESTIONS WITH AI & BIOINFORMATICS
item.description:
Category: Hackathons

Date: 27 July - 24 September 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-07-26

Venue: Online / Virtual

Fee: Not Specified

Details: Organized by INBIOSIS (Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia), i-BIOHACKATHON 2026 challenges students and industry professionals to apply data, AI tools, and critical thinking to transform precision biology and sustainability. Operating entirely without wet labs, teams of 2–4 members tackle real-world biological mysteries. Features a total prize pool of RM4,000 distributed as RM1,000 per winning track category. Registration closes on July 26, 2026.

Sub-Events:

  • Bio-Explorer Track (Secondary School): Pitch innovative ideas focused on the future landscape of AI-Powered Agricultural Biotechnology.
  • Bio-Analyst Track (Undergraduate): Analyze critical Bagworm data to devise protective solutions for Malaysian Oil Palm cultivation.
  • Systems Biologist Track (Postgraduate): Integrate complex multi-omics data sets to crack the structural prawn growth mystery.
  • Solutions Engineer Track (Industry): Develop production-ready pipelines targeting biomarkers and structural probiotics workflows.

item.title: [Congress] International AI Builders Congress 2026
item.description:
Category: Congress

Date: June 30 — December 26, 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-06-29

Venue: Daffodil International University, Ashulia Campus, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Fee: Free / Variable based on journey tracks

Details: Hosted by CloudCamp Bangladesh, the International AI Builders Congress 2026 is a premier structural execution platform designed to transition developers, innovators, and students from localized prototypes into production-grade global solutions. The comprehensive initiative focuses on key application scopes including product building, economic development, and job creation by bridging the gap between local talent and Non-Resident Bangladeshi (NRB) technology practitioners.

Sub-Events:

  • Program Schedule: Spans a multi-month structural continuum starting from onboarding sessions, routine technical check-ins, validation sprints, and interactive global mentorship labs, culminating in an expansive physical global gathering on December 26, 2026 (7:00 AM – 7:30 PM).
  • Domains & Challenges: Features structured development tasks running across 10 strategic technical domains and 50 global grand challenges. Highlighted areas focus on shipping secure, responsible, and enterprise-grade tools across healthcare, finance, legal networks, climate intelligence, agricultural modeling, civic frameworks, commerce, and fundamental AI infrastructure.
  • Judging Criteria: Solutions undergo strict evaluation across core metrics: Innovation & Originality (20%), Technical Execution & Structural Integrity (20%), Business Model & Global Sustainability Pathways (20%), alongside Measurable Real-World Impact & Ethical Compliance Protocols (20%).
  • Phases & Stages: Divided into progressive execution horizons: Phase 1 maps initial team configuration, problem identification, and technical onboarding. Phase 2 covers architecture build-outs and product development sprints under global practitioners. Phase 3 drives deployment testing, real-user validations, and international scalability readiness leading up to the final showcases.
